summary: HPC-AI launched Model APIs on HPC-AI.COM and, to celebrate the launch, offers $2 in free trial credits to all users. Users register, then claim the free voucher in the Models Console. The launch post estimates $2 covers about 4.3M input and 1.07M output tokens under a typical agent workflow. No duration or end date is stated.
claim_steps: Go to the Models Console to claim the free voucher
